build_source: Build base plus the source changes accompanying this validation record.
basis: The original game uses dynamic vertex buffers reused per vertex format. Mesa can update existing same-size stores using a discard path. In a phone recording, multiple glyphs can disappear together while neighboring elements remain in place. The cause is unresolved.
change: Build 300 alone installs an opt-in Zink GL resolver adapter before the selected 1.21 or 1.21.1 game initializes. A nonempty dynamic vertex upload of at most 256 KiB first releases the old store and then calls the real driver with the original parameters. The normal draw-order, barrier and hierarchical depth settings are used.
limitation: Allocating fresh stores may hurt frame pacing. This guard also covers qualifying world vertex uploads of the two affected versions.
checks: All 21 standard and 14 native host checks passed.
The real adapter passed an ASan and UBSan host fixture for eligible uploads, bypass conditions, and disabled mode.
The signed package passed its checksum and audit. Linked disassembly confirms the resident resolver reaches the adapter.
pending_console: Compare the title suffix and affected menus in Vanilla 1.21.1 with the trial pack off. If improved, check 1.21, Fabric and gameplay frame pacing before considering the candidate for release.
